brief: User approves the pearl/fluid UI direction; curate fitting Roky avatars preserving core character construction.

directions.name: Satin Graphite
directions.summary: Soft medium graphite, shallow face recess, warm-white eyes
directions.prompt:
Use case: product UI avatar design / identity-preserving character refinement.
The owner LOVES the pearl-white fluid Hermes Studio UI in Input 1, but wants avatars that actually belong in that visual system. Create a carefully curated FOUR-CHARACTER ROKY FAMILY, not another interface redesign.
INPUT 1: approved fluid Hermes Studio desktop + phone chat, STYLE AND IN-CONTEXT reference.
INPUT 2: canonical compact Roki/Roky portrait, CONSTRUCTION/IDENTITY reference.
INPUT 3: canonical full-body Roki, IDENTITY/SNEAKER reference.
Identity must remain Roki: a compact faceted rock construction, recognizable low pentagonal crown, inset face opening and tiny amber/orange side insert. Refine the material and proportions for the soft pearl interface. No plants, fish, animals, unrelated robots, spheres/blobs, antennae, costumes, hats, props or extra limbs. The user rejected those earlier. No gritty realistic scratches, heavy armored hood, sharp menacing facets, black void face, sinister inward slanted eyes, mouth/teeth or strong glowing eyes.
COMPOSITION: one clean LANDSCAPE 3:2 avatar art-direction sheet on neutral WHITE with a faint cool pearly glow only at the perimeter. A small title gives concept number and family name. Top 55%: FOUR LARGE HEAD-ONLY portraits, evenly spaced in a row, clearly labelled "Atlas", "Nova", "Scout", "Echo", with the role labels below. These large portraits must be true head portraits: no feet, sneakers or full-body sticker inside an icon tile. Below them show matching compact 64px-like and 28px-like samples in the very same small neutral translucent rounded tiles used by the approved UI, so the family is judged at interface scale.
Bottom 35%: two readable ACTUAL-STYLE UI EXCERPTS adapted from Input 1 — a compact four-bot roster strip using the new portraits, and Echo's message row with new portrait, name/role, a simple response and a piece of the pearl composer. Preserve the approved background/material/typographic style of these excerpts. One small full-body ECHO example may appear at the extreme bottom edge beside the profile excerpt to show how the same head works as mascot; keep sneakers understated and never use full bodies in the small icon samples. Focus on the avatar design, not giant UI windows or large illustration.
FOUR CONSISTENT SHAPES ACROSS ALL FAMILIES:
Atlas / Chief of staff: broad and low, large calm softened facets, symmetric stable silhouette, two relaxed upright eyes slightly wider apart.
Nova / Creative partner: slightly taller narrow crown, elegant asymmetric large cuts, two relaxed slim eyes with a subtly curious tilt of the whole head, not angry eye slants.
Scout / Research analyst: compact rock with one offset upper chamfer, forward-curious posture, two clear calm eyes, one a little rounder.
Echo / Writing partner: balanced rounded pentagonal rock with softer wide side facets, two gentle open happy eye marks or tiny arcs. No mouth. Enough difference from Atlas through crown and face proportions.
Material system and tiny side inserts distinguish individuals quietly; no four screaming rainbow colors. Same family, same lighting, same rendering quality. Strong silhouette and face contrast at small scale. New avatars must appear consistently in all UI excerpts. Soft even frontal light, close-cropped readable faces, no dark vignettes, no large cast shadows, no excessive glossy toy look. The whole sheet should feel like premium native UI identity work that fits the given pearlescent design.
FAMILY 01 / SATIN GRAPHITE.
Recommended natural evolution of Roki. Smooth medium GRAPHITE mineral with broad softly rounded planar facets and very subtle cool pearl reflections. Keep clearly angular rock construction, never a smooth blob. Surface is precise satin, not rough stone or shiny plastic. Face opening is shallow dark smoke-gray, not black; eyes are warm WHITE marks with almost no glow or halo. Tiny side insert is satin AMBER, crisp and restrained. Atlas medium graphite; Nova a touch lighter silver-graphite; Scout a very subtle blue-gray graphite; Echo lighter warm-neutral graphite, never brown. Differences stay quiet and sophisticated. Rounded neutral portrait tiles have nearly invisible white-glass edges. White/graphite contrast should give the light interface a calm readable focal point without looking heavy or armored. Full-body Echo keeps this exact material and simple white/gray sneakers with tiny orange sole accents.

directions.name: Pearl Ceramic
directions.summary: Cool pearl ceramic, light smoke face, graphite eyes

directions.name: Frosted Mineral
directions.summary: Smoky translucent mineral, restrained refraction, clear faces

refinements_and_in_context_prompts.prompt:
Edit the Pearl Ceramic Roky family design sheet. Preserve the whole layout, labels, four distinct body silhouettes, neutral pearl-white outer material, orange side inserts, all UI excerpts and text.
CHANGE ONLY THE FACE PANELS AND EYES, consistently in EVERY large head, small sample, roster portrait, chat portrait and full-body Echo:
Replace each dark charcoal face panel with a LIGHT COOL SMOKE-GRAY face panel, approximately #CDD2D8. It must be visibly lighter than the current face and should resemble softly inset light gray ceramic, NOT a black visor.
Replace EVERY warm glowing white/cream eye with two SMALL DARK GRAPHITE eye marks, approximately #303640, with NO GLOW OR HALO. Atlas and Nova have calm upright little oval marks; Scout has two calm slightly different dark ovals; Echo has two gentle dark happy arcs. Eye marks should be smaller and visually lighter than the existing large glowing bars.
The result is the inverse contrast of the first version: LIGHT face + DARK eyes, across all four characters and all scales. No black inset faces and no glowing cream eyes should remain anywhere. Keep a fine subtle polygon face boundary to preserve Roky's construction. Keep the amber side inserts. Do not make the outer body beige or the background purple. Preserve white UI surfaces and approved pearl-blue ambient light. Friendly, quiet and mature ceramic companions.

Edit Input 1, the approved pearl/fluid Hermes Studio desktop + phone chat screenshot. Input 2 is the NEW SATIN GRAPHITE ROKY FAMILY, the source for replacement portraits.
KEEP THE ENTIRE UI DESIGN UNCHANGED: exact desktop and phone layout, pearlescent blue/amber light background, white glass panels, thin regular typography, existing text, document/Memory/Files widgets, point-cloud activity disc, pill composer and all controls. Preserve the landscape dimensions and arrangement. Do not add a character poster, title, inset samples or new screens.
Change ONLY the existing Roky avatar portraits consistently in the sidebar, current Echo chat row, phone chat row, any team tokens:
Atlas = Input 2's broad medium-satin-graphite calm portrait.
Nova = Input 2's taller slightly lighter silver-graphite portrait.
Scout = Input 2's compact blue-gray satin-graphite portrait with a subtle chamfer.
Echo = Input 2's soft LIGHTER GRAPHITE pentagonal portrait with happy warm-white eye arcs.
Every Echo must become LIGHT SATIN GRAPHITE with a happy expression — remove the current vivid orange stone appearance. Every Scout must be quiet BLUE-GRAY GRAPHITE, not saturated cobalt. Nova remains light silver-gray, Atlas medium graphite. All retain tiny satin-amber side inserts, shallow smoke face recesses and softened faceted construction. Eyes have restrained warm-white light, no glowing halos or hostile shapes.
Use HEAD-ONLY portraits in all interface tokens; no sneakers, legs or full-body stickers inside the small circles/tiles. Fit the replacement heads inside the exact original avatar areas and preserve existing neutral translucent frames. No new floating mascot, props, humans or decorative artwork. This is the same approved UI with a cohesive refined matching avatar family, not an interface redesign.

Edit Input 1, the approved fluid/pearl Hermes Studio desktop + phone chat screenshot. Input 2 is the refined PEARL CERAMIC Roky family sheet. The user wants avatars that suit this already-approved UI.
Preserve EVERY interface detail: exact geometry, typography, text, controls, pearly blue/amber background, white glass panels, point-cloud activity disc and pill composer. No new titles, characters outside the UI, comparison rows or extra panels. Keep the original landscape composition with desktop left and phone right.
ONLY REPLACE ALL ROKY PORTRAITS with their matching LIGHT PEARL CERAMIC counterparts from Input 2:
Atlas broad cool pearl-gray faceted body; Nova taller almost-white pearl crown; Scout compact pale blue-gray chamfered mineral; Echo balanced light-gray pearl body with gentle happy dark eye arcs.
Most importantly ALL FOUR HAVE LIGHT SMOKE-GRAY FACE PANELS AND SMALL DARK GRAPHITE EYES. Do NOT use a black face recess and do NOT use warm glowing cream eyes. Their light face + dark eyes is the defining feature of this new family. A tiny satin-amber side insert is the only strong color. Match each name's character consistently in desktop sidebar, Echo's message portrait and phone Echo portrait.
Remove existing orange Echo body and saturated blue Scout body completely. Use HEAD-ONLY portraits within the existing neutral translucent avatar frames, no legs or sneakers. Keep the distinctive faceted Roki construction and asymmetrical crown from the sheet, with soft clean lighting and no rough scratches. Make the avatars quiet, friendly and clearly readable against pearl-white glass. All non-avatar pixels/content should remain visually unchanged.
